purpose: Name a person with a noticeable sensitivity or tendency.
keywords: My younger brother is sensitive to the cold.
My older sister is easily frightened and dislikes dark places.
restrictions: Only established combinations are natural; it is not freely productive with every adjective.
mistake: Distinguish the person noun 寒がり from the verb 寒がる.
